description_en: Uploads data multiple times to the IoT blockchain trusted application system
description_zh: 用于向IoT区块链可信应用系统多次上传数据
kebab_example: aliyun ltl attach-data --biz-api-version 1.0.0 --key 0001_HB5jyvZWzwcM0000_0X00_80aa976ac4d64a97bd45c71a509d0000 --value '某公司某业务数据。' --product-key HB5jyvZWzwcM0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachData

parameters.help_en: The API version number. Set the value to "1.0.0"
parameters.name: api_version

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the data key
parameters.name: key

parameters.help_en:
The user business ID. For the same key, the business ID must be unique. The value is a 64-character string. Valid characters: [0-9, a-f, A-F].
If this parameter is not specified, the latest data for the current key is returned
parameters.help_zh:
用户业务ID，同一个Key，业务ID必须唯一。格式为64字符，合法字符范围[0-9,a-f,A-F]。
如果不包含该参数，则返回当前Key最新数据
parameters.name: business_id

Data.description_en: A redundant parameter. Ignore this parameter

Message.description_en: The error message returned when the call fails
Message.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息
Message.example: The system is busy. Please try again later.

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier that Alibaba Cloud generates for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:
true: The call is successful.
false: The call fails
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
